skill.name: himalayas-remote-job-finder-with-salary-and-tech-stack
skill.description: Search Himalayas remote job listings by keyword or company and get salary range, employment type, tech stack and job page link for each role. Output fields: title, company, salaryMin, salaryMax, salaryPeriod and more, as JSON rows. Use it for requests like "Himalayas remote job", or a CSV/JSON export of public Himalayas data.
skill.summary: Find public Himalayas remote jobs through Apify, with salary filters, location restrictions, and optional skills enrichment.
skill.author: bolvein-firex

security_audit.summary: All 80 static findings are false positives: formatting, fixed reference paths, explicit input reads, and documented Apify authentication explain the matches. No evidence found of prompt injection, unauthorized exfiltration, reconnaissance, or shell injection in the supplied files. The remote Apify Actor implementation is not included, so this assessment covers only the supplied integration and documentation.

content.user_title: Find Himalayas Remote Jobs by Salary and Tech Stack
content.value_statement: Remote job research requires comparing pay, location rules, and technical requirements across listings. This skill queries an Apify Actor for public Himalayas jobs and returns structured records with configurable filters.
actual_capabilities: Submit keyword searches, browse the newest feed, retrieve company openings, or resolve specific job URLs through the documented Apify Actor.
Configure country, worldwide eligibility, seniority, employment type, timezone, and category filters.
Request annualized salary bounds and a salary currency filter without currency conversion.
Request optional job skills and company tech stack enrichment, subject to public lookup limits and data availability.
Return JSON records with job titles, employers, pay ranges, locations, posting dates, and job page links.
Run small synchronous requests through the Node helper or use documented asynchronous API requests for larger datasets.
limitations: Requires an Apify account, APIFY_TOKEN, network access, and paid Actor usage; the remote Actor implementation is not included for local verification.
Supports public listings only, with a 5,000-result keyword search limit and a maximum of 5,000 emitted records per run.
Salary filters annualize pay periods but do not convert currencies; missing pay or eligibility data requires checking the original listing.
Optional enrichment shares anonymous lookup limits of 30 per minute and 200 per day; company tech stacks may be absent.

use_cases.title: Build a targeted job shortlist
use_cases.description: Find public remote roles matching your country, timezone, preferred technologies, and salary currency.

use_cases.title: Review comparable advertised salaries
use_cases.description: Collect public roles for selected seniority levels and compare advertised pay within one currency.

use_cases.title: Track employer technology demand
use_cases.description: Retrieve selected company openings and request optional skills enrichment to summarize advertised technical requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Start a small job search
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to 25 Himalayas remote software engineer jobs. Show title, company, location, advertised pay, and job link. Mark missing fields clearly.

prompt_templates.title: Filter by eligibility and pay
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to 25 full-time Python jobs open to Canada, including worldwide roles. Use CAD and a 100000 annual salary floor. Show source links.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Narrow a shortlist by location and salary.

prompt_templates.title: Research company openings
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve up to 25 current Himalayas openings for stripe and vercel. Request job skills and company tech stacks. Group by employer and flag absent enrichment.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Compare hiring requirements across employers.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an asynchronous research export
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an asynchronous browseAll run capped at 500 jobs with skills enrichment disabled. Confirm estimated costs before execution. Retrieve completed results and summarize missing salary data.
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert: Plan a larger export with cost and completion checks.

best_practices: Start with maxItems set to 25, review Apify pricing, and inspect returned fields before increasing the run size.
Set salaryCurrency for comparable salary filters and verify pay periods and eligibility on the original job pages.
Keep APIFY_TOKEN in the environment, submit public search inputs only, and enable enrichment only when necessary.
anti_patterns: Do not submit cookies, sessions, private account data, or unrelated local JSON files to the Actor.
Do not compare mixed currencies as equivalent or assume every listing includes salary and technology information.
Do not launch large paid runs without approval or treat a still-running asynchronous dataset as complete.

faq.question: What do I need to run this skill?
faq.answer: You need an Apify account, APIFY_TOKEN, and network access. The helper requires Node 18 or later; documented shell examples use curl and jq.

faq.question: Does running the search cost money?
faq.answer: Apify bills Actor usage to your account. Check the current Actor pricing and start with a small result limit.

faq.question: Which search modes are supported?
faq.answer: The input schema supports searchJobs, browseAll, byCompany, and byJobUrls for keyword searches, feed browsing, company openings, and specific job links.

faq.question: Does the skill convert salaries between currencies?
faq.answer: No. It supports annualized salary filtering and a currency selector, but does not convert amounts between currencies.

faq.question: Will every job include skills and a company tech stack?
faq.answer: No. Both enrichments are optional and share public lookup limits. Company tech stacks may be unpublished, and enrichment can stop at the limit.

faq.question: Can I retrieve private listings or submit applications?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow retrieves public job data. It does not support private account access or application submission.
